The uncalibrated source-like drawing introduces no competing quantitative or exact-all-motion claim.

independent_source_inventory.observed: Two thin, nearly vertical cords descend from separate attachments to the same sand hopper.

independent_source_inventory.observed: An unlabelled projected oval surrounds the hopper below its open rim and above the sand trace.
independent_source_inventory.interpretation_limit: The visible source oval is retained without labeling it as a rigid ring or a circular pendulum orbit. independent_source_inventory.observed: One open tapering sand hopper with an oval rim, outlet and narrow falling stream ending on the paper trace.
independent_source_inventory.modernization: Sparse sand dots and a clean light hopper body replace scan texture, not measured grain counts or flow-rate data. The outlet-to-stream-to-trace connection is preserved.

independent_source_inventory.observed: Two opposite outward lateral arrows flank the hopper; a third arrow on the left part of the paper points toward the foreground, slightly down-left.
independent_source_inventory.scientific_fit: These remain movement indicators, not force vectors. Perspective-projected screen directions need not be at a right angle to represent the physical perpendicular swing and board directions stated in the prose.

independent_source_inventory.scientific_fit: The source order, continuous trace, seven turns and end are retained. The drawing is not a calibrated graph: it introduces no fixed period, numerical amplitude, exact undamped sine curve or additional extrapolated lobe.
